scientific_integrity: The limit is proved analytically from a Gaussian energy upper bound and an explicit Markov-block lower construction. Finite exact-rational checks do not certify the infinite limit. Originality is qualified and independent mathematical validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional interval voids for centered stationary Gaussian AR(1) displacement with fixed marginal variance and nonnegative fixed correlation below one; no prefactors, negative-correlations extension, higher-dimensional law or uniform rho-to-one limit established. A more general pre-existing Gaussian obstacle theorem could subsume the statement.
title: Exact cubic void-cost for Gaussian autoregressive perturbed lattices
